description: This file defines the BuzzLikeDao class in the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing database operations related to 'likes' on 'buzz' shares and comments within the Buzz module. It includes methods for saving, deleting, and retrieving 'like' entities, as well as filtering and counting them based on search parameters.

classes.name: BuzzLikeDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing 'like' entities on shared buzz comments and shares, providing CRUD operations and filtering functionalities.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnShare entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: saveBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Persists a BuzzLikeOnComment entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnShare
methods.description: Deletes a like on a share identified by shareId and employee number.

methods.name: deleteBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Deletes a like on a comment identified by commentId and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnShare entity by share ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentByShareIdAndEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves a BuzzLikeOnComment entity by comment ID and employee number.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnShare entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnShareCount
methods.description: Counts the number of BuzzLikeOnShare entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of BuzzLikeOnComment entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getBuzzLikeOnCommentCount
methods.description: Counts the number of BuzzLikeOnComment entities based on filter parameters.
